title: Travel
description: Get from one place to another and ask for help doing it.

questions.sentence: Apni kothay jachchen?
options: Ami station jachchi.
Ami bhaat khachchi.
Ami bari achi.
questions.correctAnswer: Ami station jachchi.
questions.translatedSentence: I am going to the station.

questions.sentence: Ei bus kothay jay?
options: Ei bus Howrah jay.
Ei bus ta khub notun.
Ami bus e jai na.
questions.correctAnswer: Ei bus Howrah jay.
questions.translatedSentence: This bus goes to Howrah.

questions.sentence: Ami train e jachchi.
options: I am going by train.
I am going by bus.
I came by train.
questions.correctAnswer: I am going by train.

questions.sentence: Tumi ki bus e jabe?
options: Na, ami metro te jabo.
Ha, ami cha khabo.
Na, ami bus ta chini.
questions.correctAnswer: Na, ami metro te jabo.
questions.translatedSentence: No, I will go by metro.

questions.sentence: Station ekhan theke kachhe.
options: The station is close to here.
The station is far from here.
The market is close to here.
questions.correctAnswer: The station is close to here.

questions.sentence: Ei train ki Sealdah jay?
options: Ha, ei train Sealdah jay.
Na, ami train chai na.
Ha, train ta khub boro.
questions.correctAnswer: Ha, ei train Sealdah jay.
questions.translatedSentence: Yes, this train goes to Sealdah.

questions.sentence: Ami roj bus e office jai.
options: I go to the office by bus every day.
I go to the office by train every day.
I went to the office by bus today.
questions.correctAnswer: I go to the office by bus every day.

questions.sentence: Apni kon station e namben?
options: Ami Howrah station e nambo.
Ami ei bus e uthbo.
Ami station ta chini na.
questions.correctAnswer: Ami Howrah station e nambo.
questions.translatedSentence: I will get off at Howrah station.

questions.sentence: Tram ta khub dhire chole.
options: The tram moves very slowly.
The tram moves very fast.
The bus moves very slowly.
questions.correctAnswer: The tram moves very slowly.

questions.sentence: Apnar koyta ticket lagbe?
options: Amar duto ticket lagbe.
Amar ticket ta ache.
Ami ticket kinbo na.
questions.correctAnswer: Amar duto ticket lagbe.
questions.translatedSentence: I need two tickets.

questions.sentence: Howrah r ticket koto?
options: Ticket ta chollish taka.
Ticket ta sesh hoye geche.
Ami taka ani ni.
questions.correctAnswer: Ticket ta chollish taka.
questions.translatedSentence: The ticket is forty rupees.

questions.sentence: Ami Sealdah r duto ticket chai.
options: I want two tickets to Sealdah.
I want one ticket to Sealdah.
I want two tickets to Howrah.
questions.correctAnswer: I want two tickets to Sealdah.

questions.sentence: Porer train koyta te charbe?
options: Porer train satta te charbe.
Porer train ta chole geche.
Ami train e uthte parbo na.
questions.correctAnswer: Porer train satta te charbe.
questions.translatedSentence: The next train leaves at seven.

questions.sentence: Train ta ek ghonta pore charbe.
options: The train leaves in an hour.
The train left an hour ago.
The bus leaves in an hour.
questions.correctAnswer: The train leaves in an hour.

questions.sentence: Ami ki ekhane ticket kinte pari?
options: Ha, ekhane ticket pawa jay.
Na, ami ticket kini ni.
Ha, ami ticket ta harie felechi.
questions.correctAnswer: Ha, ekhane ticket pawa jay.
questions.translatedSentence: Yes, tickets are available here.

questions.sentence: Ei ticket ta sara din er jonno cholbe.
options: This ticket is valid for the whole day.
This ticket is valid for one journey only.
This ticket is valid for the whole week.
questions.correctAnswer: This ticket is valid for the whole day.

questions.sentence: Apni ki jawa asha r ticket chan?
options: Na, sudhu ek dik er ticket din.
Na, ami hete phirbo na.
Ha, amar kache khuchro nei.
questions.correctAnswer: Na, sudhu ek dik er ticket din.
questions.translatedSentence: No, please give me a one-way ticket only.

questions.sentence: Line ta khub lomba, ektu opekkha korun.
options: The queue is very long, please wait a little.
The queue is very long, please come back later.
The road is very long, please wait a little.
questions.correctAnswer: The queue is very long, please wait a little.

questions.sentence: Maf korben, Howrah bridge kothay?
options: Soja giye dan dike ghurun.
Ami Howrah te thaki.
Bridge ta khub sundor.
questions.correctAnswer: Soja giye dan dike ghurun.
questions.translatedSentence: Go straight and then turn right.

questions.sentence: Bazar ta ki ekhan theke onek dure?
options: Na, hete dosh minute lage.
Ha, ami bazar e jachchi.
Na, bazar ta ekhono khole ni.
questions.correctAnswer: Na, hete dosh minute lage.
questions.translatedSentence: No, it is a ten-minute walk.

questions.sentence: Ekhan theke bam dike ghurun.
options: Turn left from here.
Turn right from here.
Go straight from here.
questions.correctAnswer: Turn left from here.

questions.sentence: Metro station ta kon dike?
options: Bam dike, ei rastar sese.
Metro te ekhon khub bhir.
Ami metro te jabo na.
questions.correctAnswer: Bam dike, ei rastar sese.
questions.translatedSentence: To the left, at the end of this road.

questions.sentence: Ditiyo mor e dan dike jaben.
options: At the second turning, go right.
At the first turning, go right.
At the second turning, go left.
questions.correctAnswer: At the second turning, go right.

questions.sentence: Apni ki ei jayga ta chenen?
options: Na, ami ekhane notun.
Ha, ami bus e jachchi.
Na, amar ticket ta nei.
questions.correctAnswer: Na, ami ekhane notun.
questions.translatedSentence: No, I am new here.

questions.sentence: Ami rasta hariye felechi, ektu sahajyo korben?
options: I have lost my way, could you help me a little?
I have lost my ticket, could you help me a little?
I have found the way, thank you for your help.
questions.correctAnswer: I have lost my way, could you help me a little?

questions.sentence: Ei rasta diye gele ki station pabo?
options: Ha, soja gele station porbe.
Na, ami station e jabo na.
Ha, rasta ta khub chowra.
questions.correctAnswer: Ha, soja gele station porbe.
questions.translatedSentence: Yes, if you go straight you will come to the station.

questions.sentence: Bus ta ei dokaner samne thame.
options: The bus stops in front of this shop.
The bus stops behind this shop.
The tram stops in front of this shop.
questions.correctAnswer: The bus stops in front of this shop.

questions.sentence: Kothay jaben dada?
options: Park Street jabo, meter e cholun.
Ami ekhane nambo na.
Amar kache khuchro nei.
questions.correctAnswer: Park Street jabo, meter e cholun.
questions.translatedSentence: I am going to Park Street, please use the meter.

questions.sentence: Meter e jabo na, sottor taka lagbe.
options: Sottor taka onek beshi, ponchash din.
Thik ache, tahole meter e cholun.
Ha, ami meter ta dekhte pachchi.
questions.correctAnswer: Sottor taka onek beshi, ponchash din.
questions.translatedSentence: Seventy rupees is far too much, make it fifty.

questions.sentence: Auto te jete das minute lage.
options: It takes ten minutes by auto.
It takes twenty minutes by auto.
It takes ten minutes on foot.
questions.correctAnswer: It takes ten minutes by auto.

questions.sentence: Ei jaygay ektu daran, ami nambo.
options: Thik ache, ekhanei thamchi.
Ha, ami aro samne jabo.
Na, ami ekhane uthbo.
questions.correctAnswer: Thik ache, ekhanei thamchi.
questions.translatedSentence: All right, I am stopping right here.

questions.sentence: Ektu taratari cholun, amar deri hoye jachche.
options: Please drive a little faster, I am getting late.
Please drive a little slower, I am getting late.
Please stop here, I am getting late.
questions.correctAnswer: Please drive a little faster, I am getting late.

questions.sentence: Bhara koto holo?
options: Ekso das taka holo.
Meter ta kharap hoye geche.
Ami taka ferot debo.
questions.correctAnswer: Ekso das taka holo.
questions.translatedSentence: It comes to a hundred and ten rupees.

questions.sentence: Ei rastay onek jam, onno rasta dhorun.
options: There is a lot of traffic on this road, please take another route.
There is a lot of traffic on this road, please wait here.
There is no traffic on this road, please take another route.
questions.correctAnswer: There is a lot of traffic on this road, please take another route.

questions.sentence: Apnar kache khuchro taka ache?
options: Na, amar kache sudhu panchsho takar not ache.
Ha, ami auto te jabo.
Na, ami bhara debo na.
questions.correctAnswer: Na, amar kache sudhu panchsho takar not ache.
questions.translatedSentence: No, I only have a five-hundred rupee note.

questions.sentence: Taxi ta meter e jay na bole ami auto niyechi.
options: I took an auto because the taxi would not go by the meter.
I took a taxi because the auto would not go by the meter.
I will take an auto if the taxi does not go by the meter.
questions.correctAnswer: I took an auto because the taxi would not go by the meter.

questions.sentence: Apnar ki ekta ghor khali ache?
options: Ha, dotalay ekta ghor khali ache.
Na, ami ekhane thaki na.
Ha, ami ghor ta porishkar korchi.
questions.correctAnswer: Ha, dotalay ekta ghor khali ache.
questions.translatedSentence: Yes, there is a room free on the first floor.

questions.sentence: Ghor ta ek rat er koto?
options: Ek rat er barosho taka.
Ghor ta khub boro o pariskar.
Ami tin din thakbo.
questions.correctAnswer: Ek rat er barosho taka.
questions.translatedSentence: It is twelve hundred rupees for one night.

questions.sentence: Amar ekta janala wala ghor chai.
options: I would like a room with a window.
I would like a room with two beds.
I would like to open the window of the room.
questions.correctAnswer: I would like a room with a window.

questions.sentence: Apni koto din thakben?
options: Ami tin rat thakbo.
Ami kal Howrah theke esechi.
Amar ekhon ghor lagbe na.
questions.correctAnswer: Ami tin rat thakbo.
questions.translatedSentence: I will stay three nights.

questions.sentence: Ghor ta bhalo, kintu ektu awaj beshi.
options: The room is nice, but it is a little noisy.
The room is nice, but it is a little small.
The room is noisy, but it is quite cheap.
questions.correctAnswer: The room is nice, but it is a little noisy.

questions.sentence: Ghor e ki garam jol pawa jay?
options: Ha, sokal e garam jol thake.
Na, ghor ta te janala nei.
Ha, ghor ta tin tolay.
questions.correctAnswer: Ha, sokal e garam jol thake.
questions.translatedSentence: Yes, there is hot water in the morning.

questions.sentence: Jodi ghor ta pochondo na hoy, tahole bodle debo.
options: If you do not like the room, I will change it.
If the room is not free, I will look for another one.
Since you did not like the room, I have already changed it.
questions.correctAnswer: If you do not like the room, I will change it.

questions.sentence: Sokaler khabar ki dam er moddhe dhora ache?
options: Ha, sokaler cha ar khabar dhora ache.
Na, ami sokale bhaat khai na.
Ha, khabar ta khub bhalo chilo.
questions.correctAnswer: Ha, sokaler cha ar khabar dhora ache.
questions.translatedSentence: Yes, morning tea and breakfast are included.

questions.sentence: Ami kal sokale ei ghor chere debo, tai bill ta toiri rakhben.
options: I will leave this room tomorrow morning, so please keep the bill ready.
I will leave this room tonight, so please keep the bill ready.
I will take this room tomorrow morning, so please keep the key ready.
questions.correctAnswer: I will leave this room tomorrow morning, so please keep the bill ready.

questions.sentence: Train ta koto khon deri te chalche?
options: Prai dui ghonta deri, karon khub brishti hochche.
Train ta thik somoy e chere geche.
Ami train e uthte pari ni.
questions.correctAnswer: Prai dui ghonta deri, karon khub brishti hochche.
questions.translatedSentence: It is about two hours late, because it is raining heavily.

questions.sentence: Apnar bag ta ki khuje pawa geche?
options: Na, ekhono pai ni, tai ami abhijog korechi.
Ha, ami kal notun bag kinechi.
Na, amar bag ta khub bhari chilo.
questions.correctAnswer: Na, ekhono pai ni, tai ami abhijog korechi.
questions.translatedSentence: No, I still have not found it, so I have filed a complaint.

questions.sentence: Amar bag ta train e phele esechi, ekhon ki korbo?
options: I have left my bag on the train, what should I do now?
I have left my bag at the hotel, what should I do now?
I have found my bag on the train, what should I do now?
questions.correctAnswer: I have left my bag on the train, what should I do now?

questions.sentence: Ei byapare ami kar sathe kotha bolbo?
options: Oi janalay je bhodrolok boshe achen, tanke bolun.
Ami apnar sathe station porjonto jabo.
Apni ektu opekkha korun, ami cha anchi.
questions.correctAnswer: Oi janalay je bhodrolok boshe achen, tanke bolun.
questions.translatedSentence: Speak to the gentleman sitting at that counter.

questions.sentence: Ami onek khon opekkha korchi, kintu keu kichu bolche na.
options: I have been waiting a long time, but nobody is telling me anything.
I have been waiting a long time, and somebody has finally explained it to me.
I waited a long time, but I did not ask anybody anything.
questions.correctAnswer: I have been waiting a long time, but nobody is telling me anything.

questions.sentence: Apnar ticket ta ki ektu dekhate parben?
options: Ha, ei je, kintu ticket ta brishti te ektu bhije geche.
Na, ami ekhono ticket kini ni.
Ha, kintu ami ticket ta harie felechi.
questions.correctAnswer: Ha, ei je, kintu ticket ta brishti te ektu bhije geche.
questions.translatedSentence: Yes, here it is, but the ticket got a little wet in the rain.

questions.sentence: Jodi ei train ta baatil hoy, tahole ami bus e Kolkata phirbo.
options: If this train is cancelled, I will go back to Kolkata by bus.
Since this train was cancelled, I went back to Kolkata by bus.
If this bus is cancelled, I will go back to Kolkata by train.
questions.correctAnswer: If this train is cancelled, I will go back to Kolkata by bus.

questions.sentence: Ei deri r jonno ki ami taka ferot pabo?
options: Ha, jodi train tin ghontar beshi deri kore, tahole taka ferot paben.
Na, ei station e ticket bikri hoy na.
Ha, apnar bag ta khuje pawa geche.
questions.correctAnswer: Ha, jodi train tin ghontar beshi deri kore, tahole taka ferot paben.
questions.translatedSentence: Yes, if the train is more than three hours late, you will get a refund.

questions.sentence: Amar bag ta kalo, ar tar upore amar naam lekha ache.
options: My bag is black, and my name is written on it.
My bag is black, and there is a name tag inside it.
My bag is brown, and my name is written on it.
questions.correctAnswer: My bag is black, and my name is written on it.
